description: REQ-002's delta/verification mechanism is specified in TWO mutually inconsistent ways with no reconciling statement, so the requirement is not concrete enough to implement unambiguously. (A) The EARS text itself (behavioral-spec.md:205-213) and the balance-read-failure Edge Case (behavioral-spec.md:255-263, anchoring PROP-016) both name 'franklin-trading balance read before vs. after the pass' (a CLI-subcommand text-parse of the literal 'USDC Balance: $X.XX' line) as the delta source -- a naive before/after snapshot across the WHOLE pass, which would also pick up any unrelated transfer that happens to land in the same window (e.g. a concurrent UBI distribution or gas top-up), silently corrupting the recorded net_usdc. (B) Independently, behavioral-spec.md's positive-delta Acceptance Criteria (lines 318-325) requires 'a LOCAL HTTP Solana RPC stub ... reporting a confirmed status and a positive USDC delta', and verification-architecture.md's PROP-005 Tool column (line 59) explicitly states the test methodology is 'sigStatus/usdcDeltaForSig mocked via injectable opts' -- i.e. skills/_shared/lib/solana-verify.mjs's sigStatus() (RPC getSignatureStatuses) and usdcDeltaForSig() (RPC getTransaction, summing ONLY that one signature's own pre/postTokenBalances -- a materially different, more precise computation than a whole-pass before/after CLI snapshot; confirmed by reading skills/_shared/lib/solana-verify.mjs:58-81 in full). These two mechanisms are NOT the same code path and can diverge in production. Neither behavioral-spec.md nor verification-architecture.md ever states which one is authoritative, whether both run and one is a cross-check, or what happens if they disagree. Compounding this: verification-architecture.md's own 'Effectful Shell' enumeration for sol-trade/run.sh (lines 34-46) lists EVERY external call this feature makes -- unset, wallet-address-solana.mjs (x2), earn-guard.mjs check, the franklin-trading CLI, franklin-trading balance, lib/record.mjs -- and never once mentions solana-verify.mjs / sigStatus / usdcDeltaForSig, even though the Purity Boundary Map (lines 15-16) lists sigStatus/usdcDeltaForSig as pure core this feature relies on and PROP-005 requires them to be invoked and mocked. I confirmed directly against the real files that skills/earn/lib/record.mjs (full file read) imports ONLY deriveLine/isProfitable/appendLedger from ledger.mjs, assertOwnIdentityOnly from identity-guard.mjs, and checkHalt from earn-guard.mjs -- it never imports solana-verify.mjs at all. So nothing in the currently-described call graph (REQ-002 prose + the Effectful Shell list + record.mjs's real imports) ever calls sigStatus/usdcDeltaForSig, yet PROP-005 -- the PRIMARY proof obligation for REQ-002's whole ledger-wiring flow, the fix for root cause 2 (the feature's own stated reason to exist) -- cannot be satisfied as described without a call to those functions that no requirement, edge case, or Files-in-scope cell ever mandates. A TDD implementer following REQ-002's prose literally builds CLI-text-parsing only and PROP-005 becomes untestable as written; an implementer following PROP-005's Tool column builds an RPC-based delta that the Edge Cases/PROP-016 never anticipated wiring degrade-on-failure semantics for. This is exactly the kind of unresolved, money-correctness-critical ambiguity Phase 1c exists to catch before Phase 2/3 burns cycles on divergent implementations.

evidence.snippet: REQ-002 EARS: '...compute this pass's USDC balance delta (franklin-trading balance read before vs. after the pass...)' vs. AC (lines 318-325): 'a LOCAL HTTP Solana RPC stub ... reporting a confirmed status and a positive USDC delta' -- two different mechanisms, never reconciled.

crossReference.snippet: Purity Boundary Map lists 'solana-verify.mjs -- sigStatus, usdcDeltaForSig ... both take an injectable fetchImpl'; PROP-005 Tool column: 'sigStatus/usdcDeltaForSig mocked via injectable opts'; but the Effectful Shell bullet for sol-trade/run.sh (lines 34-46) never mentions solana-verify.mjs / sigStatus / usdcDeltaForSig at all.

codeEvidence.note: Full file read: imports ONLY ledger.mjs (deriveLine/isProfitable/appendLedger), identity-guard.mjs (assertOwnIdentityOnly), earn-guard.mjs (checkHalt). No import of solana-verify.mjs anywhere -- confirms sigStatus/usdcDeltaForSig are not reachable through the described record() call path.

usdcDeltaForSig(signature, wallet) sums (post-pre) ONLY over token-balance entries belonging to that ONE signature via a single getTransaction RPC call -- a fundamentally different computation from a whole-pass before/after 'franklin-trading balance' CLI snapshot.
